title: Systēma Perfectī Āctīvī
subtitle: Perfectum āctīvum (λέλυκα): reduplicātiō, et sēnsus proprius — status praesēns resultāns ex āctiōne praeteritā, dīversus ab aoristō.
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē perfectum āctīvum indicātīvum verbī λύω (λέλυκα)
Applicāre rēgulam reduplicātiōnis: cōnsonāns initiālis + ε praefīxa (λύω → λε-λυκ-α)
Explicāre sēnsum proprium perfectī: status praesēns resultāns ex āctiōne praeteritā (“habeō id solūtum” magis quam “solvī”)
Distinguere sēnsum perfectī ab aoristō, comparandō cum discrīmine analogō in Anglicō (“I have solved” vs. “I solved”)

content.intro: Tertium et ultimum tempus praeteritī-related Graecum est perfectum, cum sēnsū prōrsus proprium: nōn “solvī” (aoristus, āctiō praeteritī simplex) neque “solvēbam” (imperfectum, āctiō continua), sed “solvī et adhūc status ille manet” — status praesēns, resultāns ex āctiōne iam factā. Graecum distinguit hoc systemāticē per fōrmam propriam, ubi Anglicum adhibet “have/has” + participium (“I have solved”), Lūsitānicum saepe locūtiōnem similem.
content.explanation: Perfectum indicat: āctiō est COMPLĒTA, et RESULTĀTUM eius persistit in praesentī. λέλυκα τὸν δοῦλον nōn sōlum “solvī servum [aliquandō]” (quod esset aoristus, ἔλυσα), sed “habeō servum solūtum [nunc]” — attentiō ad statum praesentem, nōn ad ēventum praeteritum ipsum.

rules.heading: a) Perfectum Āctīvum: λέλυκα
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªλέλυκαλελύκαμεν
2ªλέλυκαςλελύκατε
3ªλέλυκε(ν)λελύκασι(ν)

Fōrmātiō: REDUPLICĀTIŌ (nōn augmentum!) + thema + κα + dēsinentiae speciālēs. Īnfīnītīvus: λελυκέναι.

rules.heading: b) Rēgula Reduplicātiōnis
rules.body:
GenusRēgulaExemplum
Cōnsonāns simplexcōnsonāns + ε praefīxaλύω → λέλυκα
Vōcālis initiālisallongātiō (sīcut augmentum temporāle)ἀκούω → ἀκήκοα (specialis) / plērumque = augmentum temporāle simplex
Duae cōnsonantēs vel σ/ζ initiālēsε- sōlum (sīcut augmentum syllabicum)γράφω → γέγραφα (sed στρατεύω → ἐστράτευκα)

Reduplicātiō (nōn “augmentum”, terminus reservātus praeteritō) est signum characteristicum PROPRIUM perfectī, praesēns in OMNĪ fōrmā perfectī (indicātīvō, īnfīnītīvō, participiō) — dīversē ab augmentō, quod appāret sōlum in modō indicātīvō.

rules.heading: c) Perfectum vs. Aoristus: Discrīmen Semanticum
rules.body: Comparā: ἔλυσα τὸν δοῦλον (aoristus) = “solvī servum” (ēventus praeteritus simplex, sine attentiōne ad statum praesentem — fortasse servus iterum captus est posteā). λέλυκα τὸν δοῦλον (perfectum) = “habeō servum solūtum” (status praesēns explicitus: servus ADHŪC est līber, nunc, dum loquor). Discrīmen est subtīlis sed reāle, et frequenter ūtile in argūmentātiōne rhētoricā/philosophicā Graecā (“probāvī” [aoristus, ēventus] vs. “dēmōnstrāvī et status manet vērus” [perfectum]).

examples: λέλυκα τὸν δοῦλον· νῦν ἐλεύθερός ἐστιν. — Solvī servum; nunc līber est. (perfectum, status persistēns)
γέγραφα τὴν ἐπιστολήν. — Scrīpsī epistulam [et iam exstat, complēta]. (γράφω → γέγραφα)
πέπαυμαι — ita, sed hoc est medium; exemplum āctīvum melius: λελύκασι τὰς πύλας. — Solvērunt portās [et iam apertae manent].
οἶδα τὴν ἀλήθειαν. — Sciō vēritātem. (perfectum verbī εἴδω, sēnsū praesentī, forma valdē irregulāris et frequēns)
τί πέπραχας; — Quid fēcistī/ēgistī [et quō in statū nunc es propter id]? (πράττω → πέπραχα)
λελύκαμεν τὸν νόμον. — Abrogāvimus lēgem [et manet abrogāta].

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere reduplicātiōnem cum augmentō, crēdēns ambō esse idem phaenomenon morphologicum.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere: augmentum appāret sōlum in indicātīvō praeteritī; reduplicātiō appāret in OMNĪ fōrmā perfectī (indicātīvō, īnfīnītīvō, participiō).
commonMistakes.why: Terminologia distīncta reflectit fūnctiōnem distīnctam: reduplicātiō est pars ipsīus themae perfectī, nōn signum modī indicātīvī.

commonMistakes.wrong: Trānsferre perfectum Graecum exāctē sīcut aoristum (“solvī”), ignōrandō nuance status-praesentis.
commonMistakes.right: Trānsferre perfectum cum attentiōne ad resultātum persistēns: “habeō solūtum” magis quam sōlum “solvī”.
commonMistakes.why: Perdere hanc nuance impedit intellēctum plēnum argūmentātiōnis Graecae, ubi discrīmen perfectī/aoristī saepe est rhētoricē significāns.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere reduplicātiōnem esse semper simplex ε- praefīxum, sine cōnsīderāre variāns.
commonMistakes.right: Applicāre rēgulam secundum initium verbī: cōnsonāns simplex → cōnsonāns+ε; vōcālis → allongātiō; duae cōnsonantēs/σ/ζ → ε- sōlum.
commonMistakes.why: Variātiō reduplicātiōnis sequitur logicam similem augmentō, sed est technicē phaenomenon distīnctum.

exercises.title: Coniugā Perfectum Āctīvum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā perfectī āctīvī.

items.prompt: Ἐγὼ τὸν δοῦλον ___. (1ª sg. perf., λύω, “solvī [et manet solūtus]”)
Σὺ τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ___. (2ª sg. perf., γράφω, “scrīpsistī”)
Ὁ στρατηγὸς τὰς πύλας ___. (3ª sg. perf., λύω, “solvit [et manent apertae]”)
Ἡμεῖς τὸν νόμον ___. (1ª pl. perf., “abrogāvimus [et manet abrogātus]”)
Οἱ πολῖται τὰς πύλας ___. (3ª pl. perf.)

options: statum praesentem resultāns ex āctiōne praeteritā complētā
items.explanation: Perfectum indicat status praesēns, nōn sōlum ēventum praeteritum.

options: reduplicātiō appāret in omnī fōrmā perfectī; augmentum sōlum in indicātīvō praeteritī
items.explanation: Reduplicātiō pertinet ad thema ipsum perfectī, persistēns per omnēs modī.

items.prompt: Quod signum characteristicum distinguit perfectum āctīvum?
items.explanation: Reduplicātiō (λε-) + κα (λέλυκα) est patrōnus perfectī āctīvī.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma reduplicāta correcta verbī cuius thema incipit cōnsonante simplicī (λύω)?
items.explanation: Cōnsonāns initiālis repetītur cum ε: λε-.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma īnfīnītīvī perfectī āctīvī verbī λύω?

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Perfectum Graecum significat exāctē idem ac aoristus, sine differentiā aspectuālī.
items.explanation: Falsum: perfectum attendit ad status praesēns resultāns; aoristus, ad ēventum simplex.

items.statement: Reduplicātiō appāret sōlum in modō indicātīvō perfectī.
items.explanation: Falsum: reduplicātiō appāret in omnī fōrmā perfectī (īnfīnītīvō, participiō, quaslibet modīs).

items.statement: Perfectum āctīvum verbī λύω est λέλυκα.
Perfectum, comparātum cum Anglicō, correspondet magis “I have solved” quam “I solved”.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: attentiō ad resultātum/statum praesentem parallēla est perfectō compositō Anglicō.

summary: Perfectum āctīvum λύω: λέλυκα, λέλυκας, λέλυκε(ν) // λελύκαμεν, λελύκατε, λελύκασι(ν). Īnfīnītīvus: λελυκέναι.
Reduplicātiō (cōnsonāns+ε, vel allongātiō vōcālis) est signum characteristicum, praesēns in OMNĪ fōrmā perfectī — dīversa ab augmentō.
Sēnsus perfectī: status praesēns resultāns ex āctiōne praeteritā complētā (“habeō solūtum”), nōn sōlum ēventum praeteritum simplex (aoristus, “solvī”).
Discrīmen perfectī/aoristī parallēlum discrīminī Anglicō “have solved” vs. “solved”.
